Ollama provider sends the embedding to /api/embed and maps the native reply

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::LlmClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let req_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"input":["Hello","World"],"model":"ollama/all-minilm"}"#).unwrap();
    let req = serde_json::from_value(req_json).unwrap();
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let result = client.embed(req).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.data);
    println!("{:?}", result.model);
    println!("{:?}", result.usage.as_ref().unwrap().prompt_tokens);
}
```
